system_configurations.name: RCCL-AINIC
system_configurations.description: AINIC test plan. Group A: NetIbMPI + GIN component/unit tests (2 nodes x 1 GPU = 2 ranks). Group B: NCCL_NET plugin x knobs sweep on rccl-tests perf (2 nodes x 8 GPU = 16 ranks), including out-of-the-box autodetect. Group C: IONIC hardware counter validation. Run on the AINIC cluster with --system ainic.

mpi_args.ainic: --bind-to numa --mca pml ob1 --mca osc ^ucx --mca btl tcp,self --mca btl_tcp_if_include eno0

a_netib_component.description: A1-A3: NetIb plugin init, properties, data path.

tests.name: A1_NetIB_InitializePlugin
tests.description: Verifies IB-CAST plugin init and libionic.so load on AINIC.

tests.name: A2_NetIB_GetDeviceProperties
tests.description: Verifies IONIC devices (rdma0+) are visible and properties valid.

tests.name: A3_NetIB_SimpleSendRecv
tests.description: Verifies basic send/recv over AINIC data path (no collectives).

a_cts_workaround.description: A4: CTS-off P2P stress (16x64=1024 outstanding). Do NOT bump CTS_QP_DEPTH to 256 or it will time out.

tests.name: A4_NetIB_CtsDepthStress_CtsOff
tests.description: CTS-off P2P stress path passes cleanly (1024 outstanding recvs drain fully).

a_cts_depth32.description: A5: CTS-on at depth 32 (expected PASS). With CTS ON, CTS_QP_DEPTH=32 is well UNDER the AINIC CTS match-table overflow boundary, so this must PASS cleanly.

tests.name: A5_NetIB_CtsDepthStress_CtsOn_Depth32
tests.description: CTS ON at depth 32: under the CTS match-table overflow boundary, so this must PASS.

a_cast_base.description: CAST base: full WRR env required or tests GTEST_SKIP. No tests here; children extend.

tests.name: A6_Cast_EqualWeightsTwoQPsTokenCounts
tests.description: WRR scheduler balances 2 QPs without corruption (token table sane).

tests.name: A7_Cast_SingleQPBypassesWrr
tests.description: Single-QP connection bypasses WRR scheduler initialisation (keep sched enabled; just drop to 1 QP).

a_fault_inject.description: A8: per-QP fault injection on CAST path.

tests.name: A8_Cast_FaultInjQpErrorIsFatal
tests.description: QP fault is detected (fatal) and does not corrupt other QPs on CAST path.

a_gin.description: A9-A13: GIN one-sided proxy tests. Require NCCL_NET=ib-cast.

tests.name: A9_Gin_IPutBasic
tests.description: GIN one-sided iput RDMA write over AINIC.

tests.name: A10_Gin_IGetBasic
tests.description: GIN one-sided iget RDMA read over AINIC.

tests.name: A11_Gin_IPutSignal
tests.description: GIN put-with-signal (atomic inc/add) completion semantics.

tests.name: A12_Gin_MultipleInflight
tests.description: Multiple outstanding GIN iput/iget complete without corruption.

tests.name: A13_Gin_IPutSignalStress10k
tests.description: Stress: 10k put-with-signal ops, signal counter must equal 10000 (no drops).

b_base.description: Sweep base: derived suites run the full 1024-16G range for both allreduce and alltoall. Sets NO shared env_variables so each sweep runs against stock defaults plus its own per-suite knobs, and NO group-level command_args by design - every test sets its own explicit, complete command_args so nothing is silently concatenated/duplicated.

b1_ib.description: B1: baseline plain RoCE, no AINIC/ionic/CTS.

tests.name: B1_alltoall_IB
tests.description: Baseline plain RoCE alltoall over the full 1024-16G range - confirms HW + MPI healthy, independent of the AINIC/CAST path.

tests.name: B1_allreduce_IB
tests.description: Baseline plain RoCE allreduce.

b_alltoall_cast_full.description: Full-range CAST alltoall (1K..16G): single-QP, WRR off, CTS offload off, GDR flush off.

tests.name: B2_alltoall_CAST_1K_16G
tests.description: CAST alltoall full range 1K..16G (single-QP, CTS offload off).

b2_cast_wrr_ctsoff.description: B3: explicit CAST, WRR ON, CTS OFF.

tests.name: B3_alltoall_CAST_WRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST WRR ON / CTS OFF - validates the multi-QP CAST path on AINIC over the full 1024-16G range.

tests.name: B3_allreduce_CAST_WRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST WRR ON / CTS OFF allreduce.

b3_cast_nowrr_ctsoff.description: B4: CAST, WRR OFF, CTS OFF (isolate scheduler).

tests.name: B4_alltoall_CAST_noWRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST without WRR - isolates the scheduler, ionic QP path only, over the full 1024-16G range.

tests.name: B4_allreduce_CAST_noWRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST without WRR allreduce.

b4_rocmib_ctsoff.description: B5: ROCM-IB alias, CTS OFF (stable AINIC RoCEv2 path).

tests.name: B5_alltoall_ROCMIB_CTSoff
tests.description: AINIC alias path (sched OFF, CTS OFF) over the full 1024-16G range.

tests.name: B5_allreduce_ROCMIB_CTSoff
tests.description: AINIC alias allreduce.

b5_rocmib_ctson.description: B6: ROCM-IB alias, CTS ON on P2P.

tests.name: B6_alltoall_ROCMIB_CTSon
tests.description: ROCM-IB alltoall with CTS ON on P2P connections.

tests.name: B6_allreduce_ROCMIB_CTSon
tests.description: ROCM-IB allreduce with CTS ON.

b6_cast_wrr_ctson.description: B7: CAST, WRR ON + CTS requested ON (CTS should be forced off when sched active).

tests.name: B7_alltoall_CAST_WRR_CTSon
tests.description: WRR ON + CTS requested - verifies CTS is forced OFF under an active scheduler, over the full 1024-16G range.

tests.name: B7_allreduce_CAST_WRR_CTSon
tests.description: WRR ON + CTS requested allreduce.

b7_autodetect.description: B8: out-of-the-box autodetect. NCCL_NET intentionally omitted (do NOT set to '').

tests.name: B8_alltoall_autodetect
tests.description: Out-of-the-box: auto-select netIbCast on AINIC HW with stock defaults, over the full 1024-16G range (autodetect resolves to CAST).

tests.name: B8_allreduce_autodetect
tests.description: Out-of-the-box autodetect allreduce.

b7b_autodetect_off.description: B9: AINIC forced OFF (RCCL_AINIC_ROCE=0); expect fallback to plain IB/RoCE.

tests.name: B9_alltoall_autodetect_off
tests.description: AINIC forced OFF - verifies fallback to plain IB/RoCE on the same HW, over the full 1024-16G range for parity with the rest of the sweep.

tests.name: B9_allreduce_autodetect_off
tests.description: AINIC forced OFF allreduce.

b8_no_cts_offload.description: B10: ROCM-IB with CTS offload fully disabled.

tests.name: B10_alltoall_ROCMIB_noOffload
tests.description: CTS offload disabled - isolates the ionic path without the CTS handshake, over the full 1024-16G range.

tests.name: B10_allreduce_ROCMIB_noOffload
tests.description: CTS offload disabled allreduce.

b9_cts_force_override.description: B11: PR #4657 force-override precedence. RCCL_CTS_OFFLOAD_ENABLED=1 is the strongest override and forces CTS offload on ALL connections including P2P, overriding RCCL_IB_P2P_DISABLE_CTS=1. Exercises the `enabled && (userForced || !(isP2p && IbP2pDisableCts))` userForced branch that no other B suite covers.

tests.name: B11_alltoall_ROCMIB_CTSforceOverride
tests.description: PR #4657: RCCL_CTS_OFFLOAD_ENABLED=1 overrides IB_P2P_DISABLE_CTS=1, forcing CTS on P2P - validates the force-override precedence.

tests.name: B11_allreduce_ROCMIB_CTSforceOverride
tests.description: PR #4657 force-override on collective transport: allreduce expected PASS (CTS is supported on collective connections).

b_large_alltoall_repro.description: Dedicated large-size alltoall guard for the AINIC data path: CAST and ROCM-IB swept over the full 1K-16G range with a plain-IB control. Test names use the 1K_16G suffix to match the actual -b 1K -e 16G range.

tests.name: B12_alltoall_IB_1K_16G_control
tests.description: CONTROL: plain RoCE alltoall over 1K-16G (HW health check).

tests.name: B12_alltoall_CAST_1K_16G
tests.description: CAST alltoall over 1K-16G.

tests.name: B12_alltoall_ROCMIB_1K_16G
tests.description: ROCM-IB alltoall over 1K-16G (CAST path via alias).

tests.name: C1_alltoall_counters_CAST
tests.description: IONIC counters (tx_rdma_ucast_bytes) non-zero and BW > 10 GB/s on the IB-CAST backend. Capped at 128M to keep the counter run fast; large-size coverage lives in b_large_alltoall_repro.

tests.name: C1_allreduce_counters_CAST
tests.description: IONIC counter validation on allreduce over the IB-CAST backend.

tests.name: C1_alltoall_counters_ROCMIB
tests.description: IONIC counters (tx_rdma_ucast_bytes) non-zero and BW > 10 GB/s on the ROCM-IB backend. Capped at 128M to keep the counter run fast; large-size coverage lives in b_large_alltoall_repro.

tests.name: C1_allreduce_counters_ROCMIB
tests.description: IONIC counter validation on allreduce over the ROCM-IB backend.
